primary_verdict: incomplete, with the smallest missing implication
scope: Literal Lean-to-manuscript correspondence for six complete filtered transfer claims. The mathematical arguments inspected are sound. One corner-normalization identity remains to be exposed as a Lean endpoint.

claims.claim: An exhaustive decreasing multiplicative two-sided ideal filtration with bijective canonical map to compatible residue families supplies separated inverse-limit completeness.
claims.reason: IdealFiltration.all_mem supplies F^0=R. left_mem/right_mem derive both ideal actions. Residue is the genuine quotient relation x-y∈F^n; reduce is identity-induced. Complete asks only bijectivity of the canonical map, not a Neumann-series conclusion. separated and lift_coherent derive exactly the two components used.

claims.claim: Over any unital possibly noncommutative ring with the stated complete filtration, a finite sum of positively weighted perturbations of a unit has a two-sided inverse and a filtration-convergent signed word expansion.
claims.reason: geometric_coherent is proved from powers gaining depth; lift_coherent supplies S; residual identities and separation establish both inverse equations. weighted_inverse_from_raw_edges derives normalized edge bounds and all finite-depth congruences. Raw terms multiplied by Dinv preserve ideal depth.

claims.claim: The inverse packet block equals the signed sum over compatible chronological paths with the target corner inverse on every edge and the source corner inverse on the right.
claims.reason: ofSandwich derives left/right support from the manuscript sandwich equation. block_word_eq derives endpoint filtering, complete_diagonal_block_path_formula gives all quotient-depth equalities, assembled_corner_inverse derives the global inverse from local corner inverses. The literal identity normalizing by the assembled global Dinv versus the manuscript target-corner inverse should be added explicitly.

claims.status: passed modulo the same explicit corner-normalization bridge
claims.claim: Any lower bound d for all path weights bounds the inverse block; absent a path, the block vanishes.
claims.reason: diagonal_minimum_path_weight proves the stronger arbitrary-lower-bound statement from the completed block congruences, and diagonal_no_path_block_zero uses separation. Choosing the actual least path weight specializes that statement; the absent-path case is handled separately. No equality of valuation is asserted.

claims.claim: Finite acyclic supported transfers are nilpotent with exponent card V and yield a finite diagonal-plus-transfer inverse without completeness or positive weights.
claims.reason: Acyclic means no nonempty closed path, not an assumed path-length bound. path_cut_of_vertex_mem and vertices_nodup derive length<card V. block_word_eq then kills every length-card V term. Normalization preserves endpoint graph and acyclicity.

claims.claim: Two two-sided inverses of congruent units are congruent at the same depth.
claims.reason: inverse_stability derives Tinv-Uinv=Tinv*(U-T)*Uinv with correct noncommutative order and applies both ideal actions. No completeness assumption is used.

claims.claim: The explicit sum retaining exactly words of weight<L differs from the full inverse by F^L and has both residuals in F^L.
claims.reason: retained_length_lt proves every retained word has length<L, so N=L omits none. geometric_sub_pruned_mem removes exactly the high-weight terms. weighted_inverse_from_raw_edges derives both residuals in the original ring.

dependency_graph: IdealFiltration and canonical residue limit -> separated + coherent lift -> two-sided Neumann inverse.
Multiplicative word bounds + finite distributive expansion -> finite weight pruning -> full diagonal inverse and both residuals.
Packet orthogonality/support -> endpoint word filter -> complete path formula.
No closed nonempty path -> no repeated vertex -> length<card V -> nilpotence -> finite inverse.
Completed path congruences + lower bounds -> inverse block depth; separation -> absent-path zero.

obligations.coefficient_domain: passed: Ring R is more general than the manuscript unital algebra, with no hidden commutativity.
obligations.completion: passed: exact underlying-set inverse limit of actual residue quotients; no theorem-specific completeness witness.
obligations.chronology: passed: IsPath uses written order, ChronologicalPath uses first edge first, and isPath_reverse_iff proves reversal including empty path.
obligations.signs: passed: (-1)^length is central; length-two chronological e then f yields written f*e and positive sign.
obligations.cutoff: passed: all weights>=1 imply retained length<L; L=0 gives empty sum and assertions in F^0=R.
obligations.empty_edge_set: passed: at positive depth only the empty word remains, giving Dinv; at depth zero congruences are vacuous.
obligations.empty_vertex_type: passed: packet_sum forces the zero ring, so the exponent-zero nilpotence statement remains valid.
obligations.diagonal_path: passed: empty path forces least bound zero; no-path hypothesis is impossible on the diagonal.
obligations.source_target_support: passed for global normalized edges; local-corner identity requested explicitly.
obligations.external_inputs: Only pinned formal ring/list/finite-sum results are used. Serre background citation is not a leaf of these constructive proofs.

remaining_gap: Add (sum_i dinv_i)*N_e = dinv_target(e)*N_e and P_s*(sum_i dinv_i)=dinv_s from two-sided corner supports and orthogonal packets, then point the coverage row to these endpoints.
